summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests, mypy, Black, or any repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the format entry f"\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod, which passes the title as one two-item tuple. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise, with a Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) on the second item. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed under Unreleased, with one bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (output assertion skipped on legacy Windows), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only, mocked wrapper). Unverified: pytest, mypy, and Black results, and whether the Windows renderer test passes, since it only runs on Windows.
